name: Live chat
summary: A live stream with its chat: the stream frame with a LIVE tag and viewer count, the title, host and Follow, then a chat panel with a pinned message, messages with host, moderator and member badges, and a composer.
use: on a live stream, live class or event broadcast page
a11y: The messages are a log region that announces new ones politely and scrolls inside itself; the composer is a labelled form that sends with Enter, Follow is a toggle with aria-pressed, and the LIVE dot stops pulsing with reduced motion.

use_when: a broadcast where many viewers type short messages at once and the host or moderators pin one note above them
avoid_when: a one-to-one or small-group conversation: use chat-thread
comments that stay with a record and can be resolved: use comment-thread
a recorded video with no live audience: use video-player

parts.name: stream
parts.what: the stream frame, 16:9, with a description

parts.name: live_tag
parts.what: the LIVE tag with a pulsing dot

parts.name: viewers
parts.what: how many are watching, over the frame

parts.name: host
parts.what: the host's photo in a live ring, name, category and how long they have been live

parts.name: follow
parts.what: a Follow toggle that reads Following when on

parts.name: chat_head
parts.what: the chat heading and how many are chatting

parts.name: pinned
parts.what: one pinned message with who pinned it and an optional link

parts.name: messages
parts.what: one message: avatar, name, an optional Host, Mod or Member badge, and the text

parts.name: composer
parts.what: the message box, up to 200 characters

parts.name: emoji
parts.what: an icon button inside the box for emoji

parts.name: send
parts.what: the send icon button; it looks quiet while the box is empty

empty.how: with no messages yet, put one secondary line in the log ('No messages yet. Say hello.') and keep the composer

loading.how: show the frame as a dark box and two or three message rows as muted blocks until the stream and chat connect

error.how: if the stream drops, replace the LIVE tag with an Offline chip and show a message over the frame; if a message fails, keep it in the box with an alert-banners line above

disabled.how: Send is only dimmed when the box is empty and pressing it does nothing; set disabled on it for slow mode or a closed chat

overflow.how: the log scrolls in its own box, newest at the bottom; on a phone it grows with the page instead

long_text.how: messages break anywhere, so long words and links never push the panel wider; the title balances its lines

keyboard: Tab reaches Follow, the pinned link, the message log, the message box, Add an emoji and Send
Enter or Space on Follow turns following on or off
With the message log focused, the arrow keys scroll it
Enter in the message box sends the message when it is not empty
